subject: English
question_text: Write summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Penicillin is a life-saving medicine. Dr. Alexander Fleming invented this medicine. When the first world war broke out, Fleming joined the royal Medical Corps to serve the wonded soldiers of the battle field. His penicillin saved the lives of innumerable soldiers. For this invention Alexander Fleming was awarded nobel prize in 1945.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Shahpur Secondary School, Dumuria, Khulna. Sl. No. 74; Page No. 122
